answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing identity on a slowly refilling trust-credit only established peers may spend. To endorse a newcomer each voucher burns a non-transferable credit that regenerates at a fixed wall-clock rate, like a lagoon that refills only with the tide and never on demand. A sybil farm must separately age and fund one voucher per clone; honest standing then climbs steadily like a comet arc, while fake heads sit cold and polished as marble, earning nothing because no distinct established peer will spend scarce credit on them.
